title: Contracting homotopy of each augmented Godement stalk complex
statement: For every scheme $X$, module sheaf $F$, cosimplicial module object $A$ and augmentation $a:F[0]\to K(A)$ satisfying ModuleCupGodementModel, and every point $x$ of $X$, the map of stalk complexes induced by $a$ is a homotopy equivalence. Its inverse and homotopies are induced by evaluation of the corresponding stalk-product coordinate. No global quasi-isomorphism or flasqueness is asserted.

source.place: Godement resolution; Lemma 20.30.1 (0FKS); monad multiplication and tensor compatibility: Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, section 1.1.4, pp. 15--16.

proof.text: Project T(H) to the skyscraper at x, apply the module stalk functor at x, then use skyscraperStalkEval. The resulting e_H:(T(H))_x to H_x satisfies e_H unit_H=id by the germ and evaluation identities. Naturality in H implies that inner unit insertions commute with e, with their indices reduced by one; the outer insertion followed by e is the identity.

Transport evaluation through the term equalities of ModuleCupGodementModel. In positive degree pair adjacent terms in the alternating sum of cofaces, leaving d h+h d=id. In degree zero the remaining term is id-a r, where r is evaluation in degree zero; r a=id by the unit identity. Negative degrees are zero and all maps there are zero. The same identities say r is a chain map. They give the two homotopies required for a homotopy equivalence whose forward map is the stalk augmentation.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_godement_stalk_contraction (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    (A : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
    (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶
      (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extend
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
    (h : ModuleCupGodementModel X F A a) (x : X) :
    HomologicalComplex.homotopyEquivalences
      (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (.up ℤ)
      (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).map a)
